sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We highly value our 12-year partnership and are pleased to support your request for a 24-month contract to ensure mutual planning security. However, extending the payment terms to 60 days places an undue burden on our operations, so we propose a fair compromise of 45 days. 

Reflecting this commitment and the extended contract duration, we can revise our offer to a price of €51.60 per unit. Our current offer stands at a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €51.40 per unit. As another option, we offer a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have received your latest proposal, but we have reached the absolute limit of what we can offer for this package. Our family foundry takes great pride in the quality of our craft and the long-standing partnership we have built with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years in our region. Our price of €50.40 per unit is calculated with the utmost precision to support our long-standing partnership. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We must therefore maintain our offer of €50.40 per unit for the 24-month contract with 45-day payment terms. Specifically, our offer comprises a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

decisions.tactician: o1 at health gives the lowest C of any rung (€404,697), slightly below E0's €405,052. E0's €48.60 sits under health, so the extra relationship charge outweighs the price saving. Pay 60 d is cheapest for us, and the effective-date variants (o2-o4) have the same C. The 24-month term offers value the cash model does not count, which makes acceptance more likely. Opening at health leaves room to concede later through the step rungs. Its wage argument only supports a small increase, which our message points out without quoting figures.

why.tactician: Accepting DEMO-F1-5 locks in C €414,144, about €34.7k below the opening quote. The remaining upside is small. The o5 step rungs would save at most about €640, and the payment-term reshuffles o1–o4 save at most about €256. Any of these would push below a sheet it has declared final, and the cash model counts them as neutral or slightly negative for the supplier. E0 or any counter therefore risks losing the whole deal, and a walk-away scores 0, for a gain of well under 1 % of the savings already secured. Accepting the binding final sheet is the dominant move.
